_about: The courier office's job board (JobBoard). Each job: board (which board), order, title, taken_flag / done_flag, description (shown before taking), take {text, give_items, set_flags}, taken_text (reminder), done_text. Placeholder text (re-toned 2026-10-08, grim world) until the Writer's M6-2 sign-off. The main job is claimed at Otis's dock with the Claim Slip and finished at the tower (M4); the two side deliveries finish in town: 'The dark window above the store' when the lamp is lit on Lamp Square, 'Appeal in triplicate' when the form is dropped in the checkpoint's APPEALS slot (scenes dark_window_light and appeal_deliver in story_scenes.json).

main.title: Main: Crate to the Tower
description: MAIN JOB. Claim the crate at Otis's dock office, then run it to the Old Relay Tower.
Ordered by Watch Zero. Thermoses, cushions, and sleeve bells. The bells are contraband. Do not ask.

take.text: Job taken. Claim Slip in hand. Otis's dock office is down the stairs.

taken_text: Claim the crate at Otis's dock office, then run it to the Old Relay Tower. Why are you still reading?
done_text: Crate delivered. Stamped DONE. Nobody saw anything.

dark_window.title: Side: Window above the store
description: SIDE JOB. Lamp oil, one can, to the dark window above the store on Lamp Square. Tonight.
Pay: a Lucky Bolt and 100 credits. Oil costs a meal these days. Don't spill it.

take.text: Oil can handed over. Hold it like a week's rations. It is.

taken_text: Lamp oil to the dark window above the store. Hop the crates up to the little balcony.
done_text: Window's lit. Stamped DONE. Pay's on the sill.

appeal.title: Side: Appeal in triplicate
description: SIDE JOB. Collect a form from Pell at the docks. Deliver it to the checkpoint.
Pay: 150 credits and two Appeal Forms.

take.text: Job taken. Pell's on the docks.

taken_text: Get the form from Pell at the docks. Drop it in the checkpoint's APPEALS slot.
done_text: Appeal filed, in triplicate. Stamped DONE.
